name: rag_index
description: Trigger an incremental indexing run over one or more source paths. Unchanged files are skipped by the ingest workflow. Runs asynchronously via N8N — returns immediately with the execution id.

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: List of paths relative to target_path to index (e.g. ['core', 'docs']). Omit to index the whole target_path.

parameters.name: target_path
parameters.description: Workspace root the ingest workflow should walk. Defaults to $WYLDE_WORKSPACE_ROOT or the current working directory.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description: Logical workspace bucket — controls graph and chunk filters.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Re-index every file even if unchanged.
